create_blocks_spelling_task: create a BlocksSpelling task with custom letters and target letters for a MuJoCo simulation
generate_block_xml_pattern: generate a MuJoCo XML string for a letter block with texture and geometry properties
compute_spelling_reward: compute the reward by checking if target letter blocks overlap the target zone on the table
initialize_episode_blocks: initialize a BlocksSpelling episode by placing letter props at random positions and rotations
get_spelling_instruction: get the natural language instruction string describing which target letters to place on the table
